environment.adaptation: Saved exact LoongArch builder script and complete patch; uses staged Loongson LuaJIT and Wasmtime; reuses verified OpenSSL 3.2.0 prefix; no PCRE JIT

tests.command:
set -eu
printf '%s\n' '--- runtime image identity ---'
docker image inspect apache/apisix-runtime-deb:3.12.0 --format '{{.Id}} {{.Os}}/{{.Architecture}} size={{.Size}} title={{index .Config.Labels "org.opencontainers.image.title"}}'
printf '%s\n' '--- final image identity and parent ---'
docker image inspect apache/apisix:3.12.0 --format '{{.Id}} {{.Os}}/{{.Architecture}} size={{.Size}} parent={{.Parent}}'
printf '%s\n' '--- runtime consumer checks ---'
docker run --rm --entrypoint sh apache/apisix-runtime-deb:3.12.0 -ec 'luajit -e '\''assert(jit.arch == "loongarch64"); print(jit.arch, jit.version)'\''; openresty -V 2>&1 | head -n 3; ! ldd /usr/local/openresty/nginx/sbin/nginx | grep -F "not found"'
printf '%s\n' '--- final image consumer checks ---'
docker run --rm --entrypoint sh apache/apisix:3.12.0 -ec 'apisix version; luajit -e '\''assert(jit.arch == "loongarch64"); print(jit.arch, jit.version)'\''; openresty -t'
printf '%s\n' '--- final history begins from runtime ---'
docker history --no-trunc apache/apisix:3.12.0 | head -n 5

set -e; git -C sources/deps/luajit2-loongarch64 rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD; git -C sources/deps/luajit2-loongarch64 rev-parse HEAD; LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/openresty/luajit/lib /usr/local/openresty/luajit/bin/luajit -e 'print(jit.arch, jit.version); local s=0; for i=1,1000000 do s=s+i end; print(s)'; ldd /usr/local/openresty/nginx/sbin/nginx | grep -i luajit; /usr/local/openresty/bin/openresty -t; /usr/local/openresty/bin/openresty -V 2>&1 | grep -q -- '--with-pcre-jit' && { echo 'ERROR: PCRE JIT enabled'; exit 1; } || echo 'Nginx PCRE JIT flag is absent'
